ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity surface (approximately 90% dark pixels) with high-intensity contrast isolated to the distal tips and sections of the trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-grey/black central mass. Symmetrical high-contrast white/light-grey mottling on the outer 10% of both lobe tips. Scattered light-grey focal spots on the upper-mid region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-amplitude irregularities (10-20 pixels) at distal tips. Moderate serration frequency along the inner trailing edges with amplitude of 2-5 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge, originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of irregular, high-contrast nodules (barnacles) localized exclusively on the terminal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned parallel grey linear marks visible on the dark background of the left lobe's inner surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral encrustations (barnacles) on lobe tips; visible rake marks on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Suspended water droplets visible as vertical pixel streaks descending from the trailing edge points.
